basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Founder | Builder of Production AI Products | 3x Founder | MBA | Ships Revenue, Not Slides
basics.summary: Founder-operator with 13+ years turning AI ideas into products that ship revenue. 3 companies founded on the side (SwissNRI AI fintech, Proplab AI-for-real-estate, PulseView explainable trading AI), all built and shipped under my Anand Creations practice while running Lead AI Engineer at LumApps (2x outbound conversions, $1M forecast quarterly). At Beekeeper, built the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR) and replaced $337K/year in vendor costs with a 6-week LLM pipeline. MBA-trained (Quantic, 93.2%), speaker at Dev Innovation Summit and Front Conference, ready to go all-in on a €1B+ AI company.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales, 0 to 1 inside a scaling SaaS. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast $4M/quarter in opportunities, $1M/quarter in revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ data silos into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Same architecture I would run in a startup where trust in data is the moat.
Report directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress. Own agent architecture, eval pipelines, cost telemetry, and on-call for global production systems.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of Incubation, reporting to CIO. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Built the team, ran the GTM with Sales and PM.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Founder-mode execution inside a scale-up: identified the spend, built the alternative, killed the contract.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist and GenAI demo system for Sales. Every new signup guided at scale; every pitch personalized from Salesforce data. Both shipped with instrumentation so we knew if they moved the needle.

Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Grew engineers who now lead features independently. Co-owned GTM launches across Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis).

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions. Sit on the technology evaluation panel.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading; advised portfolio founders on hiring, AI strategy, and building companies that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for autonomous drone delivery (EPFL spin-off). Shipped end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries. Enterprise-grade from day one, closed Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.
Engineered flight control APIs and logistics optimization: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. Built CI/CD and cloud infra from scratch.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent forward deployed engineering practice and umbrella for the AI products I design, build, and run on my own (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView). Personal proof that I can go zero-to-shipped without waiting for permission or a paycheck.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax platform for Swiss-Indian families, replacing spreadsheets and expensive advisors. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions with citations back to the regulation. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in user satisfaction from feedback-driven iteration.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: AI-native platform for small real estate teams. Vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos; LLM agents turn those records into multilingual, marketing-ready listings end-to-end. One workflow from photo capture to published listing, zero copy-paste.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals with explainability built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship.
